card.name: First decimal digit after a decimal point
card.fires_on: A single digit right after the decimal point in a number such as 94.7 or 65.2. It is the first digit after the point, and it often comes before a % sign or a unit.

modes.label: Percentages
modes.description: The first decimal digit of a percentage, in demographics, voting or trial rates.
modes.example: The racial makeup of the city was 94.<<7>>6% White, 0.3

modes.label: Measurements
modes.description: The first decimal digit of a quantity with a unit such as hours, mGy, g or million tons.
modes.example: the absorbed dose to the target organ (heart wall) is 5.<<3>> mGy, 22 m

card.writes: It leans toward continuing with digits and number-like pieces, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It lights up on the digit just after the decimal point in numbers like 6.3% or 15.1 hours.
